basic_info.description: This elegant home built in 1916 has been in the same family for more than 40 years. Located on one of the lush blocks in the best Cow Hollow location, the home features:•Welcoming entry foyer and lovely traditional staircase•Dramatic large-scale living room with fireplace and leaded-glass bay windows and window seat•Double doors into the spacious formal dining room•Classic kitchen with breakfast room, pantry and back porch•Fourth bedroom/office with half bath on the main level•Sunny large master bedroom with leaded-glass bay windows and adjoining master bath•Second and third bedrooms, both opening into a second full bath•Sunroom/office with bay views•Spectacular pent room with large picture windows facing north, east and west andpanoramic Golden Gate Bridge and bay views; wet bar area•Opens to fabulous spacious solarium, which also has bay views, perfect for California style living•South-facing roof terrace with views to the bay and to the Pacific Heights skyline•Two-car garage and washer/dryer downstairs, with half bath and potential space to develop. Featured by The San Francisco Chronicle.
